node.title: Denominator-root trivialized-support shadow packing
node.closure: exact interpolation packing and quantified non-payment fence
node.statement: In the puncture-trivialized branch of the denominator-root cancellation dichotomy, each reduced support determines a unique simultaneous degree-<k explaining pair. Two distinct-slope reduced supports intersect in at most k-1 coordinates. Consequently their k-shadows are disjoint and |T|*binom(m-t,k)<=binom(n-t,k). At both deployed rows this shadow-packing upper bound is itself larger than the row budget for every 0<=t<=m-k, so it is a structural theorem but not an exception payment; further polynomial, owner, or field geometry is necessary.
